**Layout**

Three equal white-and-cream cards in a row across the slide, each 28.4% wide with 1.9% gaps, spanning x 5.9% to 94.1% and y 23.2% to 85.0%, on a 5.9% left margin. A dark GROW tag sits top-left at the margin, with the title BETTER INVESTMENTS left-aligned beneath it at x 5.9%, y 10.7%. Each card has its visual in the upper part and a cream lower panel with a slanted top edge holding a heading and two orange figures with labels. The source line sits bottom-left at x 5.9%, y 93.4%, the page number at x 2.3%, y 92.9%, and the logo bottom-right at x 87.5%, y 92.9%.

**Visuals**

Card 1 (left): a full-card photograph of a smiling woman with wavy brown hair in a cream sports top, holding a black grip handle at a machine, in front of an orange poster reading NEW CLUB, HAARLEM, VONDELWEG 540, OPENING HOURS, Monday-Friday 6:00 AM - 10:30 PM, Saturday-Sunday 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM. Composition: subject right of centre, poster filling the left and centre, framed by blue-grey gym uprights at the left and right edges. Lighting: bright daylight, warm. Dominant colours: orange, cream, blue-grey. The photo is cropped to the card and its lower edge is covered by the slanted cream panel.

Card 2 (centre): a composite illustration on white. A treadmill photograph (inset, top-left) shows people using orange-and-black treadmills in a bright gym. A second photograph (inset, top-right) shows a man in a yellow shirt leaning back on an orange machine with red dots marking his face. Below the insets, a wave graph: a dark navy line running through a grey-blue band with a shaded area on the left, rising to a second grey curve at the right. Four coloured leader lines point at the graph: blue from the treadmill inset to the band, green from the top-right inset to the band, red down to the band, green lower-right to the band. Lines are about 2 px thick.

Card 3 (right): a line chart on white with no printed data values. Y-axis labelled Target KPI (no units, no numeric scale printed), x-axis labelled Spend (no units, no numeric scale printed). Axes are thin dark grey lines with arrowheads. A black S-shaped curve labelled Saturation Curve rises from lower left to flat upper right. Three orange label boxes sit above the plot: Min (left), Current (centre, lighter orange), Max (right). Between Min and Current, and between Current and Max, orange dashed vertical guide lines bound a pale peach shaded band; orange double arrows sit inside the band (left arrow in the left band, right arrow in the right band). An orange dot marks the point on the curve at the Current guide. Lines are thin dark grey.

Bottom right: a pale light swoosh band. Footer: a small grey page-number mark and a BASIC-FIT orange logo.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream gradient, #F3E9DA to #FBF7F0, lighter toward the top-right. Warm cream gradient background, lighter toward the top-right corner (#F3E9DA to #FBF7F0). Dark charcoal tag #2D2D2D with white heavy title text. Title and figures in brand orange #FE7000. Card headings and body text in charcoal #2D2D2D. Cards are white (#FFFFFF) at the top and cream #F9F5EC at the bottom, separated by a diagonal edge rising from left to right. Typeface: HeadingPro Treble, an extended heavy grotesque sans-serif (heavy for titles, figures and headings, regular for body). Title caps approximately 5.2% of slide height; card headings about 2.2%; figures about 3.0%; body about 2.2%; source about 1.8%; page number about 1.5%. Sharp corners, no shadows, no visible borders on cards, no gradients on cards.

### Slide 59

**Text**

GROW / MORE EFFICIENT GROWTH, DELIVERED / Higher Sales / >30% 2025 VS 2023 / >10% JPC VS 2023 (on more mature state) / Lower acquisition costs & Lower cost per member / COST PER JOINER DOWN 9% SINCE 2024 / Faster maturity of new clubs / +33% MORE MEMBERS AFTER 30 DAYS VS 2023 / More efficient marketing spend / MARKETING SPEND AROUND 5% OF REVENUE / Source: Internal data 2023-2025 / 59

**Layout**

Two-column composition: a stack of four full-width-of-column content panels on the left (x 6 to 57.8 percent) and a large cut-out photograph on the right overlapping the panels' right edge. The GROW tab sits at the top-left corner at the margin, the headline runs directly beneath it on the left margin at about 10.7 percent from the top, and the source line sits bottom-left at about 93 percent. The page number is at bottom-left in the footer row and the Basic-Fit logo sits bottom-right on the cream footer wedge.

**Visuals**

Photograph: a smiling woman with dark curly hair in an orange sports bra and orange shorts and beige sneakers, squatting sideways on the floor and holding a loaded barbell whose green rubber plates are marked ZIVA and 10. She is cut out from her background (no box), placed on the right of the slide from about x 47.5 to 99.3 percent and y 13.4 to 100 percent, with the bar running horizontally to the right edge near x 97 percent. Lighting is even and soft studio light; dominant colours are orange, dark green and skin tones; the left plate overlaps the white panels at about x 48 to 58 percent. A soft grey floor shadow sits under the plates. Illustration: a dot-matrix halftone pattern of small white squares on the orange background in a hexagonal-ish cluster at top-right, x 72 to 98.8 percent and y 0.2 to 44.5 percent, behind the woman's head. Logo: BASIC-FIT wordmark bottom-right in dark charcoal with an orange figure accent. Small white icon at bottom-left at about x 2.3 percent, y 93 percent, which is the page-number mark.

**Design**

Background: Orange gradient from light orange #FFA21A at top-right to deep orange #FE7000 at bottom-left, with a cream-to-white curved wedge #F5EEE4 across the bottom-right corner. Orange gradient background moving from a lighter orange at top-right to a deeper orange #FE7000 at bottom-left. Headline and GROW tab are white in an ultra-bold, extended, all-caps geometric sans-serif (HeadingPro Treble Heavy); the headline cap height is about 5 percent of slide height. The first panel is violet #592BB2 with white text; the other three panels are white #FFFFFF with charcoal #2D2D2D labels in a regular-weight HeadingPro Treble and orange #FE7000 heavy caps values. Labels are regular weight at about 2.6 percent of slide height, values heavy at about 3 percent. **Layout**

Centred composition on a cream background. The orange KEEP heading sits at the top centre, above a cluster of interlocking gears in the middle. A photograph of three people is placed behind and to the right of the gears, and the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom right on a pale diagonal band. There is no visible footer text, slide number or grid.

**Visuals**

Full-slide photograph-style background of three people, cut out and placed on the cream background. A man in an orange t-shirt stands at the top centre and laughs. A woman with blonde hair in a ponytail, wearing a lilac top and lilac leggings, sits on a black mat at the left and laughs. A woman with long braids in a cream vest top and cream leggings sits on the black mat at the right and smiles towards the man. She holds an orange towel. The mat has '75cm' printed on it in orange at the bottom left. Lighting is soft and even, with warm neutral tones. The people are cropped at the bottom edge of the slide. Overlaid on the people is a cluster of seven interlocking cog gears: beige gears (#E8D6BF) at the back, a black gear labelled GROW at the left, an orange gear labelled MEMBER OBSESSION at the centre, a purple gear labelled KEEP at the upper right and a yellow gear labelled VALUE at the bottom. The gears have rounded, slightly soft-edged teeth and no outlines. The BASIC-FIT logo is an orange wordmark with a small figure in the letter A.

**Design**

Background is a warm cream gradient running from about #F3E6D4 at the top left to about #FBF6EE at the top right, with a pale diagonal band at the bottom right in about #FBF6EE. Title KEEP is in heavy orange #FE7000. Gear labels are in white. Gear colours: black #2A2A2A, purple #A679E8, orange #FF7A00, yellow #FFB81C, beige #E8D6BF. Typeface is a heavy geometric sans-serif (HeadingProTreble-Heavy), set in capitals. The title is about 5.2 percent of slide height and the gear labels are about 2.2 to 2.6 percent. No outlines. Gears have soft drop shadows. Photo cut-out has no border.

Photograph of four people in athletic wear, full-height on the right (x 44.4 to 91.7%), composed as a group: a laughing woman in lavender long-sleeve top on the left, a smiling man in an orange t-shirt crouching centre-right, and a woman in a white top with braids on the right; they are on a dark bench-like base with white sneakers visible at the bottom, with a soft studio light and a neutral pale background. ### Slide 65

**Text**

KEEP / BUILDING HABITS / ONBOARDING / +53% / Completed first 6 visits 4 per week / REWARDING / +33% / Increase in streak length / +27% / Members with activity streaks / MEMBERS BRING MEMBERS / +45% / Joiners from Member / Get Member programme / +90% / Converted friends / Source: Internal data 2023 - 2025 / 65

**Layout**

Three equal columns of cards sit in a row across the middle of the slide, each about 28.4% wide with 1.4% gutters, starting at x 5.9% and ending at x 94.1%, spanning y 23.2% to 85.2%. A purple KEEP tab sits in the top-left corner at x 5.8% and the title BUILDING HABITS sits left-aligned at x 5.9%, y 10.7%, below it. Each card has a photo or illustration in its upper part with a diagonal lower edge, and a text block beneath it aligned to the card's left inner margin of about 2.5%. The source line sits bottom-left at x 5.9%, y 93.4%, with a small page number to its left at x 2.3%, and the Basic-Fit logo sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Card 1 (ONBOARDING): an illustration on white showing a cluster of six elements: a smartphone at left with a lock screen reading 9:41 and a notification banner; an orange parallelogram label reading 'Body analyser' with a grey body-analyser scale and a man standing on it; an orange parallelogram label 'Notifications' pointing to the phone; an orange parallelogram label 'App' next to two phones, one showing a rocket icon and '10 CLUB VISITS!', the other showing a 'WELL DONE' trophy screen; an orange parallelogram label 'Set your goals' with a phone below it showing 'WHAT IS YOUR GOAL?'. Dashed orange circular arrows link the labels. Card 2 (REWARDING): a photograph of two smiling women in a gym, one with a blonde ponytail in a yellow top in the lower left and one with curly brown hair and a lilac top behind her, with gym equipment at the top left; the photo is cropped with a diagonal lower edge over a cream panel. A tall smartphone with a dark bezel and purple outline overlaps the photo and cream panel at the right, showing a 'Mijn data / Training / Bezoeken / Badges' tab bar, a 'STREAKS' section with badge icons labelled 1 week, 3 weeks, 4 weeks, 10 weeks, 15 weeks, 20 weeks, and an orange bottom navigation bar. Card 3 (MEMBERS BRING MEMBERS): a photograph of two women laughing in a gym, one older with blonde hair in profile at left and one younger with dark curly hair at right, with a blurred gym background of equipment and ceiling pipes; the photo has a diagonal lower edge over a cream panel. Footer: a small grey mark with the number 65 at the left, and the orange Basic-Fit wordmark logo at bottom right. Lighting is soft natural daylight in the photos; dominant colours are warm skin tones, lilac, grey and white, with orange accents.

**Design**

Background is a warm cream to beige gradient, lighter toward the top right (#F7F0E4 to #EBDCC8), with a faint lighter diagonal band across the bottom right. Titles and stat numbers are bright orange #FE7000; card headings and body text are dark charcoal #2D2D2D; the KEEP tab is a purple gradient (#5B2BB0 to #8E5BE0) with white text. Typefaces are a heavy extended geometric grotesque sans-serif (HeadingPro Treble Heavy) for titles, headings and stats, and a regular weight of the same family for body text. Title is about 5.2% of slide height, card headings about 2.2%, body about 2.2%, source line about 1.8%. Cards are flat rectangles with square corners and no shadow; the lower cream panels are #F9F5EC with a diagonal top edge cut into the photos. Card 1 is white #FFFFFF in its upper part.

**Layout**

Four equal portrait cards in a row across the middle of the slide, each about 21% of slide width with gaps of about 7%, starting at x 5.9% and ending at x 94.9%, spanning y 23.2% to 85%. A purple KEEP tab sits in the top-left corner (x 5.8%, y 0%), the title sits left-aligned at y 10.7% with its left edge at x 5.9%, and a full-width purple banner overlaps the bottom of the cards at y 84.1% to 93.9%. Card labels and figures are left-aligned inside each card with a 2.5% inset; the page number sits bottom-left at x 2.3%, y 92.9%, the source line bottom-left at x 5.8%, y 97.2%, and a Basic-Fit logo bottom-right at x 87.5%, y 92.9%.

**Visuals**

Four cards, left to right. Card 1: a cartoon illustration of a standing young woman with a mint headband, black-and-white cropped track jacket with orange trim, orange track pants with teal stripe, and mint-teal sneakers, waving with her right hand and standing with her left hand on her hip; she casts a soft grey shadow on the ground to her left; she sits on the beige card panel, full-height inside the card, with a slightly tilted cream lower panel whose top edge runs diagonally from about y 68% at left to y 63% at right. Card 2: a line chart with no axes, no tick labels, no legend, and no printed values. Two lines: an orange line starting high at left, dropping gently to a point at the 1/3 mark, then falling steeply to the right edge at the lower right; a purple line starting at mid-height at left and falling in a straight-ish diagonal to the lower right edge. Points are unlabelled; the orange line is about 2 to 3 times the stroke weight of the purple line. Card 3: a smartphone mockup, black bezel, viewed straight on, its screen showing a Basic-Fit app header in orange-to-yellow gradient with a faint dotted pattern; a circular photo of a gym floor with people and pink-magenta lighting at the top centre; the name ROOS VAN DER ZEE in white bold capitals; MemberID: 2531571121 in small white text; a white outlined pill reading Employee Member; below the header three cream rows, each with a label and icon: Lidmaatschap & Extra's with an external-link icon, Mijn persoonlijke gegevens with an external-link icon, Mijn fitnessinformatie with a right arrow; a purple button reading CHAT MET RUBY with a speech-bubble icon; a partially visible row reading LEDENK. The phone is set on an orange rectangle behind it and is cropped at the bottom by the cream panel. Card 4: a full-colour group photograph of about 40 young people, mostly women, wearing orange polo shirts with dark trim and teal lanyards, smiling and posing close together, several seated in front; lighting is even and daylight-like; composition is a tight crop with the group filling the frame edge to edge; the photo is cropped to the card and its bottom edge is diagonal, cut by the cream panel. Overlay: none. The purple banner carries no image.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream #F4EAD9 soft gradient to lighter #FBF7EF at the upper right. Warm cream background with a very soft lighter cream corner at the upper right. Title and KEEP tab text are bold, heavy, wide geometric grotesque capitals (HeadingPro Treble Heavy style), orange #FE7000 for the title, white #FFFFFF for KEEP on purple. Card labels are heavy dark charcoal capitals #2D2D2D; card figures are heavy orange #FE7000 with the unit/description in regular weight #2D2D2D. Body descriptions are a regular-weight wide sans (HeadingPro Treble Regular style) in #2D2D2D. Title size about 5.2% of slide height, card labels about 2.2%, figures and descriptions about 2.2% to 3.0%, banner figure about 4.5%, banner caption about 3.0%. Cards have square corners, no border, no shadow; card fills alternate #E8D6BF and #FE7000 at top, with cream #F9F5EC lower panels. Purple #5A2DB4 KEEP tab and banner with a subtle lighter violet gradient toward the upper right. No lines other than chart strokes.

**Layout**

A single centred composition: the orange title VALUE sits top-centre above a cluster of five interlocking gears in the middle-left of the slide. A full-height photograph of a smiling woman in an orange sports bra and orange shorts, mid-stride with one knee raised, occupies the right third. The page number sits bottom-left and the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom-right, with a wide margin on the left and no visible footer rule.

**Visuals**

Illustration: a cluster of five interlocking cog gears, each with about ten rounded teeth, arranged in a tight group. Top-left is a dark charcoal gear labelled GROW; top-right is a lavender-purple gear labelled KEEP; the centre is a larger bright orange gear labelled MEMBER OBSESSION; bottom-centre is a yellow-orange gear labelled VALUE. Behind the gears is a pale beige blob-shaped silhouette (#E8D6BF) that acts as a back layer, with soft drop shadows under the gears. Photograph: a woman with dark curly hair tied up, smiling and looking to the right, wearing an orange V-neck sports bra with a small white chevron logo and orange high-waisted shorts; her right leg is bent at the knee in a high step and her left arm is raised, hand near her chest. The photograph is cut out from its background and placed on the right side, full height of the slide, with soft warm daylight and warm cream and orange tones. Pattern: a triangular field of small orange dots in the bottom-left corner, fading toward the edges. Logo: the orange BASIC-FIT wordmark in the bottom-right corner, with a small chevron mark in the B. A cream wave-shaped band runs along the bottom edge behind the logo. A small grey pair of dots sits at the bottom left over the dot pattern.

**Design**

Background: Cream-beige gradient, lighter top-right (#FBF5EC) to warmer beige bottom-left (#EEDDC8), with the woman photograph on top and an orange dot pattern at bottom-left. Warm cream gradient background, lighter at top-right and slightly deeper beige at lower-left. The title VALUE and the gear labels use an extra-bold geometric heavy sans-serif in orange #FE7000 and white #FFFFFF. Gear fills: GROW charcoal #2B2B2B with a grey highlight, KEEP purple #A477F0 fading lighter at top-right, MEMBER OBSESSION orange #FF7A00 with a deeper #FE7000 base, VALUE yellow-orange #FFC52E fading to #FFB020 at bottom. Back blob silhouettes #E8D6BF. Page number grey #7F7F7F. Gears have soft drop shadows and no outlines. No corner radii on text; gears are rounded-tooth shapes.

**Layout**

Four equal white cards sit in a single row across the lower-middle of the slide, each with an orange icon tile overlapping its top edge and an orange uppercase label centred in its lower part. A large orange title sits left-aligned at about 18.7% from the top with a two-line subtitle beneath it, and a VALUE gear badge is pinned to the top-left corner. A purple slanted banner carries a centred quote below the cards, the page number sits bottom-left and the BASIC-FIT logo bottom-right, with a left margin of about 6% and a right margin of about 6%.

**Visuals**

Photograph of a smiling woman with curly dark hair tied up, wearing an orange sports bra and orange shorts, mid-stride in a running pose with her left hand raised toward the left edge and her right arm bent at the hip. She is cut off at the bottom of the frame and placed right of centre, occupying x 55 to 83.6 and full slide height, cut out from its background with no box. Lighting is soft and even with a neutral studio look. Dominant colours are orange, peach skin tones and dark brown hair. Four flat white icons sit in orange gradient square tiles: (1) a clipboard with a checklist and cross marks, (2) a hand holding up coins or a ball with a small circle above, (3) an ascending bar chart with an upward arrow, (4) a flexed bicep arm. A purple-to-lavender gradient parallelogram banner with a slanted left edge sits below the cards. A yellow-to-orange gear shape sits behind the word VALUE at top-left, attached to a yellow-orange rectangular band. Two orange halftone dot-pattern triangles or wedges sit at the top-right and bottom-left corners. A pale cream diagonal band runs along the bottom-right edge. The BASIC-FIT logo is an orange heavy wordmark in the bottom-right corner with a small figure inside the A.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream to peach gradient (approx. #F5EBDD to #EDD9C0) with orange dot-pattern accents. Full-bleed warm cream to peach gradient background, lighter at the top-right and deeper beige at the bottom-left. Titles and the card labels use orange #FE7000, the subtitle and page number use near-black #2D2D2D, quote text and card fills use white #FFFFFF, the banner uses purple #5B2BB0 fading to lavender #C9A0FA, the badge uses yellow #FFC629 to orange #FF9A00. Typeface is HeadingProTreble, a heavy extended geometric sans-serif for titles and labels and a regular-weight extended sans-serif for body and quote text. Main title is about 5.2% of slide height, body text about 2.6%, card labels about 3.0%, page number about 1.5%. Cards are sharp-cornered rectangles with no visible shadow. Icon tiles are sharp-cornered parallelograms with a gradient from light orange at the top to deeper orange at the bottom. Dot patterns are small orange dots in a regular grid.

**Layout**

A 2 by 2 grid of four equal panels (each about 43.7% wide by 30.1% tall) sits in the middle band between y 23.2% and y 85%, with a 4.5% gutter horizontally and about 4.2% vertically. Each panel has a photo or screenshot on the left and a white text area on the right, with a diagonal slanted edge between them; orange slanted tabs overlap the bottom-left corner of each photo. A yellow-orange VALUE tab sits top-left at the margin and the title INCREASE MEMBER VALUE is left-aligned beneath it at x 5.9%. Right-hand text in the panels is right-aligned to about x 94%. The source line sits bottom-left at y 93.4% with a small grey glyph and page number 71 at x 2.4%, and the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom-right at x 87.5% to 96%.

**Visuals**

Four photo or screenshot panels arranged in a 2 by 2 grid, each with a slanted white text panel and an orange slanted tab. Top-left: a laptop with a pricing-page screenshot (three columns, COMFORT €24,99, PREMIUM €29,99, ULTIMATE €34,99, with bulleted feature lists and an orange header bar) shown on a dark grey laptop base on a light beige backdrop, full laptop visible, slightly angled, soft shadow beneath. Top-right: a phone held upright showing a mobile app screen with an orange header, a photo of a smiling woman with the text DIE DEINER MITGLIEDSCHAFT EINEN BOOST, a purple banner, a blue-purple brain/AI graphic labelled RECOMMENDER and PERSONALISATION, and a Salesforce cloud logo in blue at its left edge; a purple banner sits at the bottom, partly covered by the tab. Bottom-left: a collage of three video or screen images. The top row shows a lit orange screen reading WELKOM BIJ BASIC-FIT, a street scene with VOLGENDE GROEPES and a pink heart-shaped love island FRANCE / AMAZON ORIGINAL sign with dancing people at sunset; below is a smiling woman in a purple top in a gym corridor with vending machines and a glowing orange display. Bottom-right: a photograph of a woman in a yellow sports top and white sneakers reclining in a black and grey massage chair, with a man in a white shirt seated beside her in a wood-panelled room; warm lighting, slightly cropped at the right where it meets the slanted edge, the chair branding is visible. Orange tabs: four slanted parallelogram tabs with orange gradient, about 15% wide by 9.5% tall, sitting across the bottom-left corner of each photo. Small grey glyph at bottom-left and the orange BASIC-FIT wordmark at bottom-right.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream diagonal gradient from beige #F3E6D3 to near-white #FBF8F2. Warm cream background with a soft diagonal gradient from beige #F3E6D3 at left to near-white #FBF8F2 at top-right. Title colour orange #FE7000. Panel headings and body text black #000000 with white text on orange tabs. Accents orange #FE7000 and orange gradient #FF9A1F to #FE7000 on tabs. The VALUE tab is a yellow-to-orange gradient #FFC629 to #FF9A1F with white text. Typefaces are HeadingProTreble, a heavy extended geometric grotesque sans-serif (Heavy for headings and numbers, Regular for body lines), in all caps for headings. Title is about 5.2% of slide height, panel headings about 2.2%, figures about 3.3%, body lines about 2.6%, source about 1.8%. Panel fills are white #FFFFFF with beige #E8D6BF photo backdrops. Shapes have square corners, straight slanted edges, no visible shadows except a soft shadow under the laptop. Thin light diagonal band at the bottom right of the slide.

### Slide 72

**Text**

VALUE
INCREASE MEMBER VALUE DELIVERED
Higher revenue per member
+6% YIELD IMPROVEMENT
(2025 vs 2023)
Stronger mix on new joiners
>40% OF JOINERS CHOOSE ULTIMATE
More value unlocked from existing members
+64% MEMBER UPGRADES
Higher revenue beyond membership
SECONDARY REVENUE CONTINUES
TO SHOW DOUBLE DIGIT GROWTH
Source: Internal Data 2023 - 2025
72

**Layout**

Full-bleed 16:9 slide with a left column of four stacked white and purple content boxes (x 6 to 57 percent) beneath a large left-aligned title at top, and a cut-out photograph of two men filling the right side (x 58 to 91 percent). A yellow tag label sits in the top-left corner above the title, the source line sits bottom-left at the same baseline as the slide number at far left, and the Basic-Fit logo sits bottom-right on a cream wedge.

**Visuals**

One full-slide background illustration: an orange gradient with a white halftone dot pattern rising diagonally in the upper right and a cream curved wedge along the bottom right. One cut-out photograph of two adult men shaking hands, placed right of centre and not boxed or cropped at the edges: the left man, dark-skinned, smiling in profile, wears a white t-shirt, white shorts and white sneakers and holds an orange object in his left hand; the right man, older with grey hair and a beard, smiling, wears a lavender t-shirt with an orange towel over his shoulders, navy shorts and black sneakers, standing on the orange ground with a soft shadow. Soft even studio lighting; dominant colours white, lavender, navy and orange. One white halftone dot pattern (illustration) in the upper right. One Basic-Fit logo in bottom-right. No charts or tables.

**Design**

Background is an orange gradient running from light orange #FF9F1C at top to deeper orange #FE7000 at bottom-left, with a cream #F3E6D3 wedge along the bottom right. Title text is white #FFFFFF in a heavy extended geometric sans (HeadingProTreble-Heavy), all caps, about 5.2 percent of slide height. Body labels are dark grey #2D2D2D in a regular-weight geometric sans (HeadingProTreble-Regular) at about 2.2 percent of slide height, except the first label which is Calibri in white. Accent values are orange #FE7000 in heavy all-caps at about 2.6 percent of slide height. Purple box #592BB2 carries white text. Boxes are plain rectangles with square corners, no borders, no shadows. Yellow tag uses a yellow gradient #FFCB2E to #FFB020.

**Layout**

Two-column framed composition under a full-width two-line title: an INPUT panel on the left, a central cluster of four interlocking gears, and an OUTPUT panel on the right, with a three-line subtitle bottom-left. The title starts at x 5.9% and sits in the top band (y 10.7% to 21.5%), left-aligned. Side panels sit between y 31% and 82.7%, with a page number bottom-left at x 2.3% and a BASIC-FIT logo bottom-right at x 87.5%.

**Visuals**

Four interlocking gear shapes forming a cluster, drawn as flat-filled cogs with soft drop shadows. Dark charcoal gear (#2D2D2D to #5A5A5A gradient, top-left lighter) labelled GROW sits at left (x 31.9% to 44.5%, y 35.3% to 59.1%). Purple gear (#7B4FD6 to #B38CF5 gradient, lighter top-right) labelled KEEP sits upper right (x 50.2% to 63.8%, y 30.5% to 54.4%). Central orange gear (#FE7000 to #FF9A2E gradient) labelled MEMBER OBSESSION sits centre (x 41.2% to 55.5%, y 39.6% to 65.8%) and overlaps the other three. Yellow-orange gear (#FFB82E to #FFC93C) labelled VALUE sits bottom (x 44.5% to 58%, y 59.1% to 81.3%). Behind the cluster is a large soft tan blob silhouette (#E8D6BF) with gear-shaped lobes, acting as a shadow cog plate. Top-right corner has an orange dotted halftone triangle pattern (orange dots on cream, cropped at the top and right edges). A faint lighter diagonal band runs along the bottom right edge. Bottom-right corner has the orange BASIC-FIT wordmark logo with a small flame-like mark in the A. No charts, photographs or tables.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream-peach gradient, lighter top-right (#F7F0E6) to warmer bottom-left (#EBD5BC). Warm cream-peach background with a soft diagonal gradient (lighter top-right #F7F0E6, warmer bottom-left #EBD5BC). Title and accents are orange #FE7000. Subtitle and panel body text are near-black #2D2D2D. Panel tabs are orange #FE7000 with white heavy text. Panels are white #FFFFFF boxes with square corners and a small arrow notch on their inner edge (INPUT notch points right at y about 49%, OUTPUT notch points left at y about 52%). Typefaces: HeadingPro Treble Heavy (wide extended heavy grotesque, all caps) for title, labels and figures; HeadingPro Treble Regular for list items and descriptors (sans-serif). Title size about 5.2% of slide height with line spacing about 1.0; subtitle about 3.7%; body items about 3.0%; small labels about 2.2%. Parallelogram-slanted orange tabs (top edge offset right) hold INPUT and OUTPUT. Gears have soft blurred drop shadows.

**Layout**

The title block is left-aligned at about 14.5% from the left edge and sits in the vertical middle of the slide, starting at about 31% of the height. A cream band crosses the bottom with the BASIC-FIT logo at bottom right. There is no visible footer text, page number or date.

**Visuals**

1) Photograph (right side, x 42.4 to 100%, full height, 2021 by 2001 px source, cropped with a diagonal left edge): a smiling young woman with hair pulled back, looking up and to the right, wearing a peach/salmon sleeveless sports top. She rests her forearm on a gym machine and holds a teal and orange water bottle at the lower right edge. The background is a blurred gym interior with grey ceiling, orange and black equipment. Lighting is warm, natural and soft, with bright highlights on her face. Dominant colours are peach skin tones, orange, grey and cream.
2) Orange gradient panel (left, x 0 to 74.9%, full height): bright orange (#FE7000) with a lighter yellow-orange (#FFA040) toward the diagonal edge and subtle diagonal texture lines.
3) Purple light streak (far right, x 79.4 to 100%, full height): a vertical violet (#7B3FE4) gradient beam behind the photo.
4) Dot pattern (x 77.4 to 100%, y 35.8 to 100%): a field of small white dots over the purple area, partly overlapping the photo edge.
5) Chevron outline (left of title, about x 5.8 to 12.3%, y 31.8 to 65.3%): a right-pointing chevron drawn as a thin white outline, stroke about 0.5% of slide width, no fill, open to the left.
6) Cream band (bottom, x 0 to 100%, y 83.5 to 100%): a light cream/beige (#F2EDE4) band with a diagonal top edge rising to the right, overlapping the bottom of the photo.
7) Logo BASIC-FIT (bottom right, x 82.3 to 97.8%, y 88.1 to 96.1%): orange (#FE7000) wordmark 'BASIC-FIT' in a bold condensed sans with a small figure silhouette replacing the letter A.

**Design**

Background: Orange gradient (#FE7000 to #FFA040) on the left, blending into a full-bleed photograph of a smiling woman in a gym on the right, with a cream band along the bottom. Left panel uses an orange gradient from #FE7000 to lighter #FFA040 toward the right edge; right side is a photograph with purple #7B3FE4 accent light and white dot texture; bottom band is cream #F2EDE4. Title text is white #FFFFFF, set in an extra-heavy wide grotesque sans-serif (HeadingProTreble-Heavy), all capitals, tight line spacing, about 12.2% of slide height per line (cap height about 8.5%). No body text. Accent colour orange #FE7000 for logo. Chevron outline in white, thin stroke. No corner radii, no shadows on text. Photo has no tint on the subject area; the orange panel is a flat gradient.

A smiling woman with curly brown hair stands beside him in an orange sports bra and orange high-waisted shorts, one knee raised onto the box and one hand on her hip. A red-orange water bottle stands on the box. Background is a warm beige studio backdrop. Lighting is soft and even. Figures are cropped at the bottom edge of the slide. **Layout**

Four equal chart panels arranged in a 2 by 2 grid below a left-aligned two-line title block, with a thin dashed cross-divider at the centre (vertical at about x 50 and horizontal at about y 54) and the panel headings left-aligned at the top-left corner of each quadrant. The title sits top-left at about y 10.7 with the subtitle beneath it at about y 16.4; the left margin is about 5.9 percent of the width. The footer carries the slide number at bottom-left (x 2.3, y 92.9), a left-aligned footnote at x 5.9, y 92.8, and the Basic-Fit logo at bottom-right (x 87.5, y 92.9).

**Visuals**

Four bar charts with arrow overlays, one per quadrant. Top-left: column chart titled '# of clubs', y axis 0 to 2,000 in steps of 400 with unit clubs (unlabelled), x axis years 2016 to 2025, orange (#FE7000) columns with values 419, 521, 629, 784, 905, 1,015, 1,200, 1,402, 1,575, 1,716 (2016 to 2025), with an orange arrow rising from lower-left to upper-right and the callout '17 % CAGR 2016 – 2025'. Top-right: column chart titled '# of memberships ('000s)', y axis 0 to 5,000 in steps of 1,000, x axis years 2016 to 2025, light lavender (#D1B0FF) columns with values 1,211, 1,520, 1,843, 2,221, 2,001, 2,220, 3,352, 3,802, 4,254, 4,933, with a lavender arrow and the purple callout '17% CAGR 2016 – 2025' in #5B1FD6-like violet. Bottom-left: column chart titled 'revenue (€ million)', y axis 0 to 1,600 in steps of 400, x axis years 2016 to 2025, white (#FFFFFF) columns on the cream background with values 259, 328, 402, 515, 377, 341, 795, 1,047, 1,215, 1,420, a dark charcoal arrow and the callout '21% CAGR 2016 – 2025'. Bottom-right: column chart titled 'underlying EBITDA less rent* (€ millions)', y axis 0 to 400 in steps of 100, x axis years 2016 to 2025, charcoal (#2D2D2D) columns with values 80, 101, 124, 155, 94, 32, 204, 261, 313, 348, a charcoal arrow and the callout '18% CAGR 2016 – 2025'. No legend, no highlighted points; the 2025 column is the tallest in each panel and is not separately highlighted. Gridlines are absent; axis baselines are thin light grey lines. Value labels sit above each column in bold dark text. The Basic-Fit logo is a bold orange wordmark with a stylised figure in the 'A' area.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream-to-peach gradient, #EBD8C3 at lower left blending to #F8F3EC at upper right. Warm cream gradient background from peach #EBD8C3 at the lower left to off-white #F8F3EC at the upper right. Titles in heavy extended grotesque, orange #FE7000, all caps. Subtitle in regular-weight geometric grotesque in charcoal #2D2D2D. Panel headings in heavy weight, charcoal #2D2D2D. Chart value labels in heavy weight, charcoal #2D2D2D; axis tick labels in regular weight, grey #808080. Title cap height about 5.2 percent of slide height; subtitle about 3.3; panel headings about 1.7; chart labels and footnote about 1.3 to 1.5. Lines are thin 1 px and dashed in pale tan #E3CDB8 for the dividers and solid for arrows, with arrows about 1.5 px charcoal or colour matched and pointed arrowheads. Columns are flat with square corners, no shadows, no gradients on the bars.

### Slide 77

**Text**

EFFICIENT COST STRUCTURE INTENSIFIED
Basic-Fit owned clubs
LOW BREAK- EVEN / POINT
Efficient build-out and low- / cost structure lead to fast / payback period
ECONOMIES OF / SCALE
Lower cost per club
OPERATIONAL / EXCELLENCE
Scale drives / professionalization / of back-office services
INDUSTRY COST / LEADERSHIP
DIGITAL VALUE / DELIVERY
Digital service (App, AI / coaching) scalable / without staffing costs
INCREASED BUYING / POWER
Buying power leads to better / prices for fitness equipment, / consumables and services
CENTRALIZED / PLATFORM
One technology stack / for app, data and / membership management
EFFICIENT / STAFFING
Technology enabled unstaffed / opening hours and absence / covering
AUTOMATION
Automation reduces / administrative work while / maintaining member / experience
77

**Layout**

Eight orange cards sit in a three-by-three grid with the centre cell occupied by a purple panel labelled INDUSTRY COST LEADERSHIP; the grid spans roughly 5.8% to 94% of slide width and 23% to 88% of height. The title is centred at the top (y about 10.7%) with the subtitle centred beneath it, and the cards use a left-aligned icon-plus-text pattern. A purple arrow sits between each card and the centre panel, and the slide number is bottom-left with the Basic-Fit logo bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Eight white line-style icons, one per card. Top-left card: a balance scale. Top-middle card: a bar chart with a rising trend arrow. Top-right card: a gear inside a circular arrow loop. Middle-left card: a mobile phone with a grid of app icons. Middle-right card: a flexed bicep arm. Bottom-left card: a desktop monitor and stacked server units. Bottom-middle card: a group of five people figures under a dotted arc. Bottom-right card: a monitor with a gear. Eight purple (#5B2BB8) arrows: up arrow above the top-middle card, down arrow below the centre panel above the bottom-middle card, left arrow beside the middle-left card, right arrow beside the middle-right card, and four diagonal arrows at the corners of the centre panel pointing outward to the corner cards. A photograph of a smiling middle-aged man with short grey hair, grey t-shirt, grey shorts and black sneakers, holding a black dumbbell in each hand, standing as a cut-out figure; he overlaps the lower-right corner of the centre purple panel and the edge of the middle-right card. Decorative orange dot-grid patterns in the top-right and lower-left corners, and a pale cream diagonal band along the bottom edge. Basic-Fit logo bottom-right: orange wordmark with a small figure. Slide number 77 in grey.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream diagonal gradient from #F3E6D4 to #FAF4EC, with orange dot-pattern decorations at the corners. Warm cream background with a soft diagonal gradient from #F3E6D4 at upper left to #FAF4EC at lower right. Title is orange #FE7000, heavy extended grotesque sans-serif in capitals, about 5.2% of slide height. Subtitle is dark grey #2D2D2D, regular extended sans-serif, about 3.3% of slide height. Card headings are white heavy extended sans-serif capitals about 2.2% of slide height; card body text is white regular extended sans-serif about 1.7% of slide height with tight leading. Cards are orange gradient from #FF9F1C at top right to #FE7000 at bottom left, with square corners and no visible shadow. Centre panel is purple gradient from #C9A6FF at top left to #7B2FF7 at bottom right. Arrows are purple #5B2BB8 thin strokes. Dot patterns are orange #FE7000 at low opacity. Slide number is grey #7F7F7F, heavy sans-serif.

### Slide 78

**Text**

A NEW ERA, A NEW FOCUS / From pure growth to high quality growth / RAPID SCALE UP (2016–19) / Focus on rapid roll-out of new owned clubs in very immature European fitness market / Average annual growth rates of >20% / PANDEMIC & RECOVERY (2020–24) / Maintain high pace of club growth / Margins impacted by government-imposed COVID measures and higher inflation / GROWTH & HIGH-QUALITY RETURNS (2025–30) / European fitness market still underpenetrated / Multi vertical approach / Capital efficient growth / Focus on profitable growth / ROCE target medium-term low to mid teens / * ROCE is defined as EBIT divided by total assets minus current liabilities / 78 / BASIC-FIT

**Layout**

Three white cards sit in a horizontal row of staggered heights across the lower-middle of the slide, stepping upward from left to right, with the card headings in orange capitals at the top of each card and bullet lists beneath. The title and subtitle are left-aligned at the top-left with a left margin of about 6 percent. A footnote runs along the bottom left beside the page number 78 at the far left, and the Basic-Fit logo sits bottom right on the cream band.

**Visuals**

Full-bleed orange gradient background. A photograph of a smiling man with a barbell on his shoulders, cropped at the bottom edge of the slide, occupying the right half and standing behind the cards; he wears a pale yellow T-shirt, dark shorts and has his hair pulled back; lighting is bright and even, framing is waist-up to cut-off at the bottom, and the image is not boxed. A purple-to-violet diagonal stripe runs down the right edge behind the photo. A cream diagonal band runs across the bottom right under the cards. Two small orange square icons with white right-pointing chevrons sit on the edges between cards one and two and cards two and three. Each bullet has a small orange dumbbell icon. The Basic-Fit logo, an orange wordmark with a small figure, sits bottom right.

**Design**

Background is an orange gradient, lighter yellow-orange top right (#FFA41C) shifting to deeper orange bottom left (#FE7000). Titles and subtitle are white (#FFFFFF). Card headings and chevrons are orange #FE7000. Body text and footnote are dark grey #2D2D2D. Accent colour is orange #FE7000 and purple #6B2FD1 on the right stripe. Title typeface is HeadingProTreble Heavy, a wide heavy grotesque sans-serif in all caps, about 5.2 percent of slide height. Subtitle and body are HeadingProTreble Regular, a wide sans-serif, subtitle about 3.3 percent and body about 2.2 percent of slide height. Card headings are HeadingProTreble Heavy at about 2.6 percent. Cards are white rectangles with square corners and no visible shadow. Chevron squares are orange with square corners.

**Layout**

Cream full-bleed slide with three columns. The bold orange title sits top-left at about 10.7% from the top, with a dark grey subtitle line directly beneath it, both left-aligned at a 5.9% left margin. Column headings sit at about 23% from the top: GROWTH APPROACHES over the left funnel diagram, KEY ROCE DRIVERS over the centre gear cycle, and MEDIUM-TERM GROUP TARGET (two lines, centred) over the right orange panel. A cut-out photograph of a man stands at the right edge and overlaps the panel's right side, and the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom-right. The page number 81 sits bottom-left at about 93% from the top.

**Visuals**

Left: a funnel diagram. Two orange rectangular pills labelled Organic and Inorganic sit side by side at the top, each with a white translucent trapezoid below it narrowing into a single orange pill labelled Franchise. A white down arrow runs from Franchise into an open bowl with an orange elliptical rim at the top, drawn as a light cream-to-white gradient vessel. A large white hollow arrow loops from the bottom of the bowl: it runs up on the left, returns across the bottom, rises on the right and turns right into a white arrowhead pointing toward the centre column. Centre: three gears connected by curved arrows, read top to bottom. The top gear is orange (Asset turn), the middle gear is yellow-orange (Margin), and the bottom gear is violet (Cash generation). An orange curved arrow arcs over the top of the first gear, a yellow arrow runs down the left side from the Asset gear to the Margin gear, and a purple arrow runs down the right side from Margin to Cash generation, with an arrowhead pointing at the bottom. Right: a tall orange gradient panel with a white target-and-arrow icon near its top, the bold white word ROCE, and the white text low to / mid teens %. Far right: a full-body cut-out photograph of a smiling older man with grey hair and a short grey beard, wearing a lilac-grey t-shirt, blue-grey shorts and black-and-white trainers. He is lifting a black dumbbell at shoulder height with one arm and holding a second dumbbell at hip height, his stance is upright and frontal, and the light is soft and even studio light. A small orange BASIC-FIT wordmark logo sits at bottom right.

**Design**

Background: Cream-to-white gradient, from about #EFDFC9 at the lower left to #FAF6EE at the upper right. Warm cream background with a subtle light gradient from pale beige at the lower left to near-white at the upper right. Title in heavy orange #FE7000, subtitle and column headings in dark charcoal #2D2D2D. Typeface is HeadingPro Treble (a wide geometric grotesque sans-serif), Heavy for titles and headings and Regular for body and subtitle. Title cap height is about 5.2% of slide height, subtitle about 3.3%, column headings about 2.6%. Shapes have sharp square corners, no outlines and no shadows. The Organic, Inorganic and Franchise boxes use an orange gradient from #FFA526 at the top to #FE7000 at the bottom. The target panel uses a vertical gradient from #FFA11F at the top to #FF7A00 at the bottom. Gears are flat with soft radial shading: orange #FF8C1A, yellow #FFC929 and violet #7B4FD6 with a lighter centre. Value labels in bold near-black #2D2D2D sit about 1.5% above each bar top. An orange trend arrow (#FE7000, thin line about 1.5px, arrowhead at upper right) runs from about (10.7%, 58.8%) to about (53.2%, 28.1%) above the bars, with large bold orange '18%' and smaller orange text 'CAGR since 2016' set along it, rotated about -20 degrees. Icons: four small orange dumbbell-style bullet icons beside bullet points in the right panels. Logo: BASIC-FIT wordmark in orange with a small figure icon. No photographs.

**Design**

Background is a warm cream-to-beige diagonal gradient, darker beige #EDD9C2 at bottom-left shifting to pale cream #FAF6EE at top-right, with a faint lighter diagonal band at lower right. Title in extended heavy sans (HeadingPro Treble Heavy style) in orange #FE7000, all caps, with large size. Chart title and body text in #2D2D2D near-black; panel headings CURRENT DEVELOPMENT and GOING FORWARD in heavy orange #FE7000, all caps. Bullet text in regular-weight grotesque sans (HeadingPro Treble Regular style). Title text about 5.2% of slide height; panel headings about 2.6%; body text about 2.0%; data labels about 1.8%; footnote about 1.7%. White panels #FFFFFF, square corners, no visible shadow. Bars use orange gradient #FFA726 to #FF7000. Page number #7F7F7F.

### Slide 84

**Text**

CONTINUED RAPID MEMBERSHIP GROWTH / New club openings and further growth of memberships per owned club / History of total memberships at owned clubs / (millions) / 1.21 / 1.52 / 1.84 / 2.22 / 2.00 / 2.22 / 3.35 / 3.80 / 4.25 / 4.93 / 18% / CAGR since 2016 / 2016 / 2017 / 2018 / 2019 / 2020 / 2021 / 2022 / 2023 / 2024 / 2025 / CURRENT DEVELOPMENT / 5.1 million memberships Q1 2026 / Up 682,000 or 15% year on year / GOING FORWARD / Membership growth through new club openings / Further growth of memberships per club / 84

**Layout**

Two-column grid on a cream background: a wide white chart panel occupies the left column (about 6% to 58% of width, 23% to 85% of height) and two stacked white text panels occupy the right column (about 59% to 94% of width, 23% to 53% and 55% to 85% of height). The title sits top-left at about 10.7% of height with a grey-dark subtitle beneath it, both left-aligned to x 5.9%. Slide number 84 sits bottom-left at about 93% height and the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom-right; the left margin is about 6% and the right margin about 6%.

**Visuals**

Bar chart, vertical, titled History of total memberships at owned clubs (millions). Ten orange bars with a gradient from light orange at the top (#FFA52A) to deeper orange at the base (#FE7000), one bar per year 2016 to 2025, each labelled with its value printed above it: 2016 1.21; 2017 1.52; 2018 1.84; 2019 2.22; 2020 2.00; 2021 2.22; 2022 3.35; 2023 3.80; 2024 4.25; 2025 4.93. The bars are drawn to scale with the printed values; no y-axis, gridlines or axis range are printed, and the bars share a thin light grey baseline. Year labels sit under each bar in dark grey. A thin orange arrow with an arrowhead runs diagonally from just above the 2016 bar (about x 20%, y 63%) up to the right to about x 52%, y 30%, passing over the bars, annotated with the text 18% in large heavy orange followed by CAGR since 2016 in small orange capitals on the arrow's upper side. No legend. Highlighted points: none beyond the arrow. Bullet markers on the right panels are small orange dumbbell icons, one per bullet, at x about 61%. No photographs or logos other than the BASIC-FIT wordmark.

**Design**

Background is a soft cream gradient, lighter at top right (#FBF6EE) and deeper beige at bottom left (#EBD6BF). Titles are heavy extended display type in orange #FE7000, subtitle and body text in dark charcoal #2D2D2D, chart value labels in charcoal #2D2D2D, page number in grey #7F7F7F. Typefaces: a heavy wide grotesque for titles and chart labels (close to Heading Pro Treble Heavy, sans-serif, extra bold, all caps for headings) and a regular wide grotesque for subtitle and body (Heading Pro Treble Regular, sans-serif). Title is about 5.2% of slide height, subtitle about 3.3%, panel headings about 2.6%, body about 2.0%, chart title about 2.2%, value labels about 1.8%. Panels are flat white rectangles with square corners and no visible shadow or border. Bars have a vertical gradient fill and square tops. Accent colour orange #FE7000 throughout.

### Slide 85

**Text**

MATURATION OF CLUB NETWORK / Growth of memberships per club increases with maturation / History of maturation of club network / Rapid scale up / Pandemic / Recovery / and continued / growth / 57% / 43% / 53% / 47% / 48% / 52% / 48% / 52% / 37% / 63% / 37% / 63% / 29% / 71% / 2016 / 2017 / 2018 / 2019 / 2020 / 2021 / 2022 / 2023 / 2024 / 2025 / MATURATION OF CLUB NETWORK / Strong membership ingrowth in the first / two years / A club is seen as mature when it is at / least 24 months old at the start of a year / Significant growth in number of clubs / limits growth in average members per / club / Current growth pace increases level of / maturity / In 2026, approximately 20% of the clubs / are immature / 85

**Layout**

Two white panels sit side by side below the title block: a wide chart panel on the left (about x 5.9 to 57.9%, y 23.2 to 85.0%) and a narrower text panel on the right (about x 59.2 to 94.1%, same top and bottom). The slide title is top-left at x 5.9%, y 10.7%, with the subtitle directly beneath it; both are left-aligned on a common margin of about 6% of width. The page number sits bottom-left at about x 2.3%, y 92.9%, and the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom-right at about x 87.5%, y 92.9%.

**Visuals**

Chart: stacked vertical bar chart titled 'History of maturation of club network', with ten bars for years 2016 to 2025 on a horizontal baseline (about x 8.6 to 55.3%, y 79%). Each bar has an orange top segment and a beige bottom segment with the percentage printed inside each segment. 2016: orange 57%, beige 43%. 2017: orange 53%, beige 47%. 2018: orange 48%, beige 52%. 2019: orange 48%, beige 52%. 2020, 2021 and 2022: no values, drawn as light grey (#F2F2F2) placeholder bars of full height with a lower and upper grey segment each, grouped under the 'Pandemic' label. 2023: orange 37%, beige 63%. 2024: orange 37%, beige 63%. 2025: orange 29%, beige 71%. The chart has no y-axis, no numeric scale and no legend; the orange segments are the top share and the beige segments are the bottom share of each bar. Above the bars are three phase brackets: an orange arrow spanning 2016 to 2019 labelled 'Rapid scale up', a light grey arrow spanning 2020 to 2022 labelled 'Pandemic', and an orange arrow spanning 2023 to 2024 labelled 'Recovery and continued growth'. Highlighted points: none. Right panel: five bullet points, each marked with a small orange dumbbell icon, no chart.

**Design**

Background: Diagonal beige gradient from about #EBD9C2 (left and bottom-left) to about #FAF6EF (top right), with a lighter cream diagonal band across the bottom right. Warm beige gradient background, lighter at top right and darker cream at left. Titles are bold, wide, heavy display sans-serif in orange #FE7000, all caps. The subtitle and body text are regular-weight wide geometric sans-serif in dark charcoal #2D2D2D. Panel headings are heavy display sans in #2D2D2D (chart) and #FE7000 (right panel). Title text is about 5.2% of slide height; subtitle about 3.3%; body and bullets about 2.0%; chart labels about 1.8%. Accents are orange #FE7000. Bars: orange segments use a vertical gradient from #FFA826 at top to #FE7000 at bottom; beige #E8D6BF; pandemic placeholders #F2F2F2. Panels are plain white #FFFFFF with slightly rounded corners (about 0.5% of width) and no visible shadow. Bullet dumbbell icons are orange #FE7000.

**Layout**

Full-width title block sits top-left at about 5.9% from the left edge, with the bold orange title above a dark grey subtitle line. A wide orange KPI band spans the upper middle left of the slide, with a slanted orange result tag at its right end and a short note beneath the tag; below, a white panel holds a three-bar chart with a centred heading. Slide number sits bottom-left and the Basic-Fit logo sits bottom-right, with generous margins.

**Visuals**

Bar chart titled 'A PROVEN BUSINESS MODEL…' with the subtitle 'As network matures average members per club will see an increase in memberships'. Three bars of Members x Club on a flat baseline with no visible axes or numeric scale: FY2024 bar solid orange labelled 2.7K (about the lower-left bar, shorter than FY2025); FY2025 bar solid orange labelled 2.9K; Medium-term bar hatched with diagonal lavender stripes labelled 3.2K in violet. A lavender bracket line runs from above the FY2025 bar to the top of the Medium-term bar with an arrowhead pointing down at the Medium-term bar, labelled +300 Estimated incremental members. Equation band: five KPI figures with operators, a slanted tag at right, all text in white on an orange gradient. No photographs or logos inside the band; Basic-Fit wordmark logo in orange at bottom-right; small grey page-number glyph at bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream gradient from #F3E6D5 at left to #FBF6EF at upper right, with a faint lighter sweep at the bottom right.

**Layout**

Two-column grid on a 12-column-style split: a wide white chart card on the left (about 52% width) and two stacked white cards on the right (about 35% width, equal heights, 2.5% gap-free vertical spacing of about 2.4% between them at x 59.2). The title sits top-left at x 5.9% with a bold orange headline at y 10.7% and a regular dark subtitle directly beneath at y 16.4%. Left margin is about 5.9%, right margin about 6.4%, bottom of cards at about 84.8%. Text is left-aligned throughout. A small grey slide number sits bottom-left at x 2.3%, y 92.9%; the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Chart: vertical bar chart, titled 'History of average yield in owned Basic-Fit clubs (€ per month, ex VAT)'. X axis: years 2016 to 2025 (categorical, no axis title printed). Y axis: no axis labels or scale printed; bars start from a common baseline at about y 72.5% of slide height (horizontal baseline line, light grey, about 0.2% thick, spanning x 8.4% to 55.1%). Series (single series, values printed above each bar): 2016 19.46; 2017 19.41; 2018 19.39; 2019 20.56; 2020 14.50; 2021 13.05; 2022 22.86; 2023 23.53; 2024 24.24; 2025 24.91 (€ per month, ex VAT). Bars 2016 to 2019 and 2022 to 2025 are orange gradient (top about #FFA526, bottom about #FF7A00); bars 2020 and 2021 are highlighted in light grey gradient (about #D6D6D6 at top to #F2F2F2 at base), indicating the lower values. No legend. Bar width about 2.7% of slide width, roughly evenly spaced at about 4.7% pitch. Bullet icons: three small orange dumbbell glyphs (about #FE7000) before the Current Development bullets and two before Going Forward bullets. BASIC-FIT logo bottom-right: orange (#FE7000) wordmark 'BASIC-FIT' in heavy condensed letters with a small figure icon in the first letter area, on a light lower-right band. No photographs.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream diagonal gradient, about #FAF6EE at top-right to #EBD9C4 at bottom-left, with a lighter band at bottom-right. Warm cream background with a soft diagonal gradient, lighter at top-right (about #FAF6EE) and deeper peach at bottom-left (about #EBD9C4). White rectangular cards with square corners and no visible borders or shadows. Title: heavy extended geometric sans-serif (HeadingPro Treble Heavy style), all caps, orange #FE7000, about 5.2% of slide height. Subtitle: regular weight of same family, dark grey #2D2D2D, about 3.3%. Card headings: heavy caps orange #FE7000, about 2.6%. Chart title: heavy, dark #2D2D2D, about 2.2%. Body bullets: regular weight, #2D2D2D, about 2.0%. Data labels: heavy, #2D2D2D, about 1.8%. Year labels: regular, #2D2D2D, about 1.8%. Slide number: heavy, grey #7F7F7F, about 1.5%. Accent colour orange #FE7000 used for headings, bars and icons.

**Layout**

Two-column layout on a full-bleed slide. The left column (about 0 to 45% of width) holds a photograph of five people with a dotted lilac panel behind them. From left: a smiling grey-bearded man in a lilac t-shirt, blue-grey shorts and black-and-white trainers with one hand on his hip; a smiling man with arms folded in an orange-red t-shirt and orange-red shorts; a smiling woman with hair pulled back in a yellow sports bra and yellow leggings, standing behind; a smiling woman with short blonde hair in a lilac tank top and lilac leggings, standing with one hand on the other's hip; and a smiling woman crouching in front in an orange long-sleeve seamless top and orange leggings. **Layout**

Two-column layout: two equal white cards sit side by side below a left-aligned two-line title and a single-line subtitle, with the left card narrower in content and the right card holding four bullets. A full-width white timeline band runs along the bottom with four year markers (2010, 2015, 2020, 2025) on an orange line, and logos placed above and below it. The title sits top-left at about 5.9% from the left edge; the slide number sits bottom-left at 2.3% and the Basic-Fit logo bottom-right; the man photo occupies the right edge from top to bottom, overlapping the right card edge.

**Visuals**

Photograph: a smiling man with a dark topknot and yellow t-shirt, black shorts with white stripes and white trainers, performing a split lunge with a loaded barbell resting on his shoulders; he is shown from head to feet, cut out (no background), placed at the right edge of the slide (x 69.6%, full height, 964 by 1786 px) on orange, partly overlapping the right white card and bottom timeline band. Lighting is even studio light; dominant colours are yellow, black, and skin tones against orange. Decorative swoosh: a pale cream-to-white wedge (about #F5EFE6) fills the bottom-right corner from about x 28% to the right edge, low in the slide, behind the Basic-Fit logo. Timeline: a horizontal orange line (#FE7000, about 0.5% of slide height thick) from x 7% to 90% with an arrowhead at the right end; four solid orange circular markers (#FE7000) at about x 11.5%, 37.5%, 63.6% and 88.5% on the line above year labels. Logos: Basic-Fit (orange wordmark, top-left of timeline, 9.2% x, 74.7% y, 7.6% wide); Fitness First (dark blue script, 14.2% x, 79.2% y, 10.1% wide); JUSTFIT.BE (blue and red wordmark, 40.4% x, 77.0% y, 7.6% wide); Gymstreet (black and orange wordmark with a figure, 52.3% x, 80.3% y, 8.7% wide); FITLAND (orange and grey wordmark, 58.9% x, 77.8% y, 7.6% wide); McFit (yellow and black mark with wordmark, 79.2% x, 74.6% y, 7.6% wide); clever fit (red and black, 87.2% x, 75.6% y); Basic-Fit footer logo (orange wordmark, 87.5% x, 92.9% y, 8.5% wide). Text-only names: Sportopolis, McGym, LA Gym.

**Design**

Background is a bright orange gradient from #FF7000 at lower-left to a lighter #FFA21F at upper-right. Titles are white (#FFFFFF) in a heavy wide geometric sans-serif (HeadingPro Treble Heavy), uppercase, about 5.2% of slide height for the main title and 3.3% for the subtitle in regular weight, white. Card headings are orange #FE7000 uppercase heavy sans at 2.6%. Body and bullet text is dark grey #2D2D2D in HeadingPro Treble, with bold lead-in phrases at about 1.85% of slide height and regular continuation text. Accents are orange #FE7000 bullets shaped as small dumbbell icons. Cards are plain white #FFFFFF rectangles with square corners and no shadow or border. The timeline band is a plain white rectangle with square corners. Year labels are dark grey regular sans at about 1.67%.

**Layout**

Four-card row on the right and a white chart panel on the left share a common top edge at about 32.6% of slide height, under a left-aligned two-line title block at the top-left margin (5.9% from left). The title sits at 10.7% from the top, the subtitle directly beneath it, and the page number bottom-left and the BASIC-FIT logo bottom-right form the footer at about 93% of slide height.

**Visuals**

Bar chart (left white panel) titled 'EBITDA MULTIPLE TO DECREASE ON IMPROVED PROFITABILITY:' with three vertical bars on a light grey baseline and no y-axis or numeric scale. Bar 2024 is purple gradient (#C9A9F7 top to #592BB2 bottom), labelled with the purple value 11-12X above it, bar 2025 is orange gradient (#FFA028 top to #FE7000 bottom) labelled 8X, bar 2027E is orange gradient of the same colours labelled 3-6X. A thin orange #FE7000 elbow arrow runs from just right of the 11-12X label horizontally to the right, then down, ending in a downward arrowhead above the 3-6X bar, showing the decline from 11-12X to 3-6X. Bars are approximately proportional: 2024 about 100%, 2025 about 65%, 2027E about 40% of the baseline-to-top height; no values are printed other than the labels. ### Slide 92

**Text**

DELIVERING ROCE / ENHANCING GROWTH / Diversified across three growth approaches / ORGANIC / INORGANIC / FRANCHISE / ROCE / ENHANCING / GROWTH / 92 / BASIC-FIT

**Layout**

Two-column composition on a 16:9 slide. The left 45 percent holds a full-height cutout photograph of a woman on a weight bench, overlapping a purple-to-lavender diagonal panel. The right side holds a stacked title block at top, then three horizontal bars (ORGANIC, INORGANIC, FRANCHISE) at left, each with an icon tab, and a tall tan panel at far right that spans the height of the three bars. The title and subtitle are left-aligned at x 45.5 percent, top at 10.7 percent. A page number sits bottom-left at x 2.3 percent and the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom-right at x 87.5 percent, both on the cream wedge. Margins are about 2 to 3 percent on the sides.

**Visuals**

Photograph: a cutout of a smiling woman with long curly blonde hair, wearing an orange long-sleeved seamless top and orange leggings, grimacing and leaning forward with her left hand on a black padded weight bench and her right arm holding a black dumbbell at hip height. She wears white low-top sneakers and is standing with one knee on the bench, stepping up. The bench is black with a grey padded top and steel frame. Lighting is soft studio light, falling from the upper left. Framing is a medium full-length shot, cut out from its background with no edge, and the figure is not cropped. Dominant colours are orange #F7941D, black and white. A halftone dot pattern of small white dots fades from top to the woman's shoulder area, overlaid on the purple-lavender diagonal gradient panel. Three bars: ORGANIC bar tan with a kettlebell and dumbbell icon on an orange tab; INORGANIC bar tan with a three-person group icon on an orange tab; FRANCHISE bar purple gradient with a map-pin and map icon on an orange tab. A tall tan panel at far right with an orange text label. The tabs have small notched right edges. Arrow-like chevron points on the right edge of the first two tan bars and on the purple bar. Logo: BASIC-FIT wordmark in orange, bold condensed letterforms with a small figure in the A, on the cream background.

**Design**

Background is a warm orange gradient, #FE7000 at the bottom-left to #FFA21A toward the upper right, with a purple gradient panel #7A2FE0 to lavender #C9B6F0 on the left side. Titles are white #FFFFFF. Body text is white #FFFFFF. Labels ORGANIC and INORGANIC are dark charcoal #2D2D2D. FRANCHISE label is white. Accent text in the right panel is orange #FE7000. Bars are tan #E8D6BF. Purple bar gradient runs from lavender #B07CFF at the top-left to deep violet #6A2BD6 at the bottom-right. Typeface is HeadingProTreble, an extended heavy grotesque sans-serif. Title is HeadingProTreble Heavy all caps, about 5.2 percent of slide height, which is roughly 2.2 times the body text size. Subtitle is HeadingProTreble Regular, about 3.3 percent of slide height. Labels are HeadingProTreble Heavy caps, about 2.6 percent of slide height. Tan bars and panel have sharp corners. Tabs are orange gradient parallelograms with slightly slanted right edges. No shadows. The purple bar has a soft gradient fill.

**Layout**

Three white cards sit in a row across the middle of the slide, each with an orange icon tile overlapping its top-left edge, under a title at top left. The title, cards and body note align to a left margin of about 6% and the cards span roughly 6% to 94% of the width. A two-line body note sits bottom left, the slide number bottom left at about 2% and the Basic-Fit logo bottom right; a photograph of two men occupies the right side and overlaps the middle and right cards.

**Visuals**

Three orange gradient icon tiles (slanted parallelograms, about 6.5% by 11% of the slide) sit on the top edges of the three cards: left tile shows a stack of coins, middle tile shows a banknote with a euro symbol, right tile shows a hand holding up dots, representing services. A photograph of two men at right: on the left an older man with grey hair and beard, in a lilac top with an orange and white towel over his shoulder, facing right; on the right a smiling young man in a white t-shirt with his hands raised in a high-five gesture toward the older man. They are standing on a pale beige floor, shown full-length from the mid-torso down to the shoes, with black and white sneakers, lit evenly with soft daylight, cut out from the background and placed over the cards. Dominant colours are beige, white, orange and grey. A decorative orange halftone dot pattern occupies the top-right corner, fading out toward the centre. The Basic-Fit logo is orange wordmark at bottom right.

**Design**

Background: Cream-to-beige gradient, light #F7EEDF at top right to peach #EBD8C0 at bottom left, with a photograph and dot pattern on top. Warm cream-to-beige gradient background with light tones at top right and a deeper peach at bottom left. Large percentage figures in heavy display sans-serif, orange #FE7000, about 5.9% of slide height. Body note in regular wide sans-serif, dark grey #2D2D2D, about 2.6% of slide height. **Visuals**

Waterfall (bridge) chart with no printed y-axis, gridlines or numeric scale. Categories left to right: 2025 (orange total bar, labelled 1,420), New clubs (small grey floating bar, unlabelled, about 1.5% of the axis height above the previous level), Existing clubs (grey floating bar, about 13% of plot height), Yield growth (grey floating bar), Clever Fit owned (grey floating bar), Franchise (grey floating bar), 2026 (orange total bar, labelled 1,640 – 1,690), Selective M&A (grey floating bar with white-to-grey gradient, unlabelled), 2026 (orange total bar, unlabelled, taller than the first 2026 bar). Category labels are rotated about 20 degrees below the baseline. Brackets with labels: High single-digit member growth spans New clubs; Low single digit yield growth spans Yield growth; Low single-digit other growth spans Clever Fit owned and Franchise. An orange arrow-connector with a bracket from the 1,420 bar rises to an orange banner reading DOUBLE-DIGIT GROWTH and continues right to the 2026 label. No legend. No values printed for grey bars; the bar heights are approximate. Highlighted points: the two orange total bars and the orange DOUBLE-DIGIT GROWTH banner. Lighting is bright and even. Dominant colours are orange, lavender, grey and yellow. Framing is medium, slightly cropped at the top and right, boxed rectangle, not full-bleed. Dumbbell icons (small orange) precede each of the four bullet points. BASIC-FIT logo in orange bold letters with a small figure mark at bottom right.

**Layout**

Four equal white cards sit in one row across the lower half, evenly spaced with a left and right margin of about 6 percent, each card 21 percent wide and 39 percent tall. The title block is centred horizontally in the upper third, with the orange title above a dark grey two-line subtitle, and the photograph spans the full slide behind everything. The slide number sits bottom-left and the Basic-Fit logo bottom-right, both inside the margins.

**Visuals**

Full-bleed photograph of a smiling woman with a ponytail performing a side plank: her body is angled diagonally from lower left to upper right, her left arm extends straight up and exits the top edge of the slide (cropped), her right hand rests on the floor at lower left, and her legs extend to the right with white sneakers visible at lower right near the logo. She wears a peach/coral sports bra and coral leggings. Lighting is soft and even, warm skin tones, composition is a full-length cutout with the figure occupying the left two-thirds, cropped at the top by the raised arm and at the bottom by the floor. Dominant colours are peach, coral and cream. A soft shadow falls on the cream floor beneath her. Two decorative dotted patterns of small orange dots in a triangular fade: one at top right, one at bottom left, both partly cropped by the slide edges. Four orange number tabs (1, 2, 3, 4) sit on the top edges of the cards as slanted parallelograms with a vertical orange gradient. Small orange dumbbell-shaped bullet icons precede each bullet item. The Basic-Fit logo is an orange wordmark at bottom right.

**Design**

Background: Cream-to-peach gradient (approximately #F5EBDD) with the full-bleed photograph of the woman placed over it. Cream to pale peach background with a soft diagonal gradient; titles in orange #FE7000, subtitle and body text in dark grey #2D2D2D, card headings in orange #FE7000, numbers in white #FFFFFF on orange tabs. Typeface is HeadingPro Treble: a heavy extended grotesque for titles, card headings and numerals (about 5.2 percent of slide height for the main title, 2.96 percent for card headings, 1.49 percent for the page number) and a regular weight of the same family for subtitle and body (3.34 percent for subtitle, 2.22 percent for body). Card shapes are white rectangles with square corners and no visible shadow. Tabs have slanted left and right edges with an orange gradient from light orange #FF9A1F at top to #FE7000 at bottom.

**Layout**

Three equal white cards sit side by side in a three-column grid below the title, spanning roughly x 5.9% to 94.1% and y 30.4% to 85.1%, with equal gaps of about 3% between them. The title sits top-left at y 10.7% with a subtitle beneath it, both left-aligned on a 5.9% left margin. Each card has a bold heading at its top-left. The first two cards each hold a two-bar comparison with a baseline and labels; the third card holds an icon and a centred stacked label. A footnote sits bottom-left and the page number sits at bottom-left beside it, with the logo bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Two paired vertical bar comparisons and one icon panel. Chart 1: bars with the title 'SLOWED DOWN ORGANIC ROLLOUT…'. Left bar is purple gradient, labelled 155 on top and 'Average net new club rollout' above its base, with category label 'Avg. L5Y' below. Right bar is orange gradient, labelled 'c. 60' above and 'New club openings*' above its base, with category label '2026' below. The purple bar is about 2.3 times as tall as the orange bar. An orange arrow line runs from just right of the 155 label, horizontally then down, ending in an arrowhead pointing down at the c. 60 label. Chart 2: title '…AND REDUCED AVERAGE CAPEX...', left bar purple gradient labelled €332 with 'Average capex' above its base and category 'Avg. L5Y' below; right bar orange gradient labelled 'c. €210' with 'capex' above its base and category '2026' below. The purple bar is about 2.2 times as tall as the orange bar. An orange arrow line runs from just right of the €332 label, horizontally then down, ending in an arrowhead pointing down at the c. €210 label. Neither chart prints a value axis, scale or legend; bar heights are not printed numbers, so ratios above are estimates. Icon panel: an orange parallelogram tile (slanted left and right edges, about #FE7000 to #FF9A1F gradient) holds a white pictogram of a standing person, arrows and a square, circle and triangle shapes. Below it the words FRANCHISING AND SELECTIVE M&A are set in orange. Footnote and page number are text only. Logo: BASIC-FIT orange wordmark with a small figure in the 'A'.

**Design**

Background: Diagonal gradient from warm beige #EFE2D0 at lower-left to cream #F7EFE3 at upper-right, with a faint lighter band at bottom-right. **Layout**

Single title centred at the top across the full width, above three equal white columns of identical height arranged side by side with even gutters. Each column has an orange slanted header tab at its top-left edge overlapping the card top, then section subheads and bullet lists left-aligned inside the card; the page number sits bottom-left and the logo bottom-right, both inside the margin.

**Visuals**

Three orange slanted header tabs with white two-line labels, one above each white card. Small orange dumbbell-shaped bullet glyphs precede every bullet line. A dotted-pattern triangular motif of orange dots sits at the top-right corner, partly behind the right card's top edge. A pale beige diagonal band runs along the bottom edge. The Basic-Fit logo (orange wordmark with a small figure) sits bottom-right. No photographs, charts or tables.

**Design**

Background: Warm cream-to-beige gradient, lighter cream at top right (about #F7F0E6) fading to sandy beige at bottom left (about #E8D5BD), with a pale diagonal band at the bottom.

**Layout**

Two-column layout on a 16:9 slide: a left column of four stacked white cards and a right column holding one white chart panel, both starting at about 23% of slide height and ending near 85%. The title sits top-left at about 11% from the top, left-aligned at a 5.9% margin. The page number is bottom-left at about 93% from the top and the BASIC-FIT logo is bottom-right.

**Visuals**

One bar chart titled 'Debt maturity (millions)' in the upper-left of the chart panel. It is a stacked vertical bar chart with categories 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030, 2031 on the horizontal axis, and no value axis or gridlines are printed. The bars are: 2026 has one segment, Put option convert, labelled 145, in orange. 2027 has one segment, Bilateral, labelled 330, in lavender. 2028 is stacked from bottom to top as Convertible bond labelled 159 (orange gradient), Bilateral labelled 180 (lavender), and SFA labelled 70 (yellow). 2029 has one segment, SFA, labelled 730, in yellow. 2030 and 2031 have no bars. The baseline is a thin light grey horizontal line. Bar heights are proportional to the printed values, with no axis scale. The legend sits below the year labels in one row: orange square Put option convert, orange-light square Convertible bond, lavender square Bilateral, yellow square SFA. No points are highlighted. Four dumbbell-shaped orange icons mark the four bullet cards.

**Design**

Background: Soft diagonal gradient from beige #EFDFC9 (lower-left) to near-white #FAF6EE (upper-right), with a faint lighter swoosh band across the bottom right. Warm cream background with a soft diagonal gradient from beige #EFDFC9 at lower-left to near-white #FAF6EE at upper-right. Title in heavy wide grotesque (HeadingPro Treble Heavy, sans-serif) in orange #FE7000, all capitals. Body text in regular HeadingPro Treble weight, dark grey #2D2D2D. Chart labels in heavy weight #2D2D2D. Accents are orange #FE7000, lavender #D1B0FF and yellow #FFD12E. Cards and chart panel are plain white #FFFFFF rectangles with square corners, no visible border and no shadow. Title is about 5.2% of slide height, body text about 2.2%, chart labels about 1.8%.

**Layout**

Two-column layout on a 12-column-equivalent grid: a left column of four stacked white cards (x 5.9 to 47.4 percent) and a right white chart panel (x 49.6 to 94.1 percent, y 23.2 to 85.0 percent). The title sits top-left at y 10.7 percent, left-aligned at x 5.9 percent, above both columns. The page number 103 sits bottom-left at x 2.1 percent, y 92.9 percent; the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom-right at x 87.5 percent, y 92.9 percent. Left margin is about 6 percent and right margin about 6 percent.

**Visuals**

Chart: stacked column chart titled 'Debt maturity (millions)' with no visible y-axis, no gridlines, and no numeric axis range; a thin light grey baseline runs under the bars at about 74 percent of slide height. X-axis categories: 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030, 2031. Series and labelled values: Put option convert (orange #FF6A00 with slight gradient): 2026 = 145. Convertible bond (orange #FF8C1A with gradient): 2028 = 159; 2031 = 308. Bilateral (lilac #D1B0FF): 2028 = 180. SFA (yellow #FFD12E): 2028 = 70; 2029 = 730. Bars for 2027 and 2030 have no value. Bar heights are proportional to the printed values and share the same baseline. Legend below the plot, centred, in one row: orange square Put option convert, orange square Convertible bond, lilac square Bilateral, yellow square SFA. No bars are highlighted. Four small orange dumbbell icons sit at the left of each card as bullet markers, with the 2031 bar (308) and the 2028 bar (159) as the largest orange blocks. Decorative: a full-slide peach gradient and a lighter white diagonal band across the bottom right, behind the logo.

**Design**

Background is a soft peach-to-cream diagonal gradient, darker beige #EBD9C4 at lower-left to near-white #FAF6F0 at top-right. Title is set in an extra-heavy extended geometric display sans (HeadingPro Treble Heavy style), all caps, orange #FE7000, roughly 5.2 percent of slide height. Body text is a regular-weight wide geometric sans (HeadingPro Treble Regular style), dark charcoal #2D2D2D, about 2.2 percent of slide height. Chart labels are heavy sans, #2D2D2D, about 1.8 percent of slide height; axis year labels are regular weight. Accent colour is orange #FE7000 for title and bullet icons. Cards are flat white #FFFFFF rectangles with square corners, no borders, no shadows, separated by about 0.8 percent vertical gaps. Chart panel is a flat white #FFFFFF square-cornered rectangle with no shadow. Page number is heavy sans in grey #7F7F7F, about 1.5 percent of slide height.

Two equal white cards sit side by side in the lower-middle of the slide, the left card under the orange '2026' tab and the right card under the orange 'MEDIUM-TERM' tab, with the same top edge at about 28.6% of the height. The title GUIDANCE and subtitle sit top-left, left-aligned at about 6% margin, with the subtitle beneath the title. A footnote line runs along the bottom left with the page number at its far left, and the BASIC-FIT logo sits bottom right.

Bottom-right: a faint lighter diagonal band (image spanning x 28 to 100, y 89 to 100) across the footer area. Two orange parallelogram tabs with a gradient from amber #FFA126 at top right to orange #FE7000 at bottom left, slanted so the top edge is offset to the right, each carrying white bold text. Ten small orange dumbbell icons (#FE7000), one before each bullet, five in each card. Logo: BASIC-FIT wordmark in orange #FE7000 with a small figure cut into the letters, at bottom right. ### Slide 105

**Text**

THANK / YOU!

**Layout**

Full-bleed closing slide split diagonally: an orange gradient panel fills the left and centre-left, and a photograph fills the right with a diagonal boundary running from top (about x 63%) to bottom (about x 45%). The title block sits left of centre at about x 13.5% to 54.8%, vertically around y 26% to 58%, left-aligned with an outlined chevron marker to its left. A cream footer band runs along the bottom edge from about y 84% and carries the Basic-Fit logo at the bottom right. No slide number or footer text is present.

**Visuals**

Photograph of a smiling middle-aged man with short greying hair and a greying beard, wearing a lavender short-sleeved technical T-shirt with a small dark triangle logo and the words 'NIKE TRAIL' on the chest, leaning forward in a gym. Behind him is a barbell loaded with black and orange weight plates and a dark wall with large faded lettering reading 'MAKE IT' and 'HOT' repeated. The photograph is cropped to a diagonal edge on its left side, is not boxed and runs to the top, right and bottom edges. Lighting is warm and low-key with a dark grey and brown background and warm highlights on the face. Dominant colours are dark grey, warm brown, lavender and orange. A purple translucent diagonal beam with a white dot-matrix halftone pattern overlaps the right edge of the photograph. A white outlined chevron pointing right sits to the left of the title. Basic-Fit logo in orange (#FE7000) with a small white figure silhouette in the letter A, placed on the cream band at the bottom right.

**Design**

Background is an orange gradient panel (#FF7A00 to #FE7000 with a lighter #FFA040 edge near the diagonal) on the left, with the photograph on the right and a cream band (#F2F2F2 tint, about #F3EEE6) along the bottom. Title text is white (#FFFFFF) in a heavy, wide geometric sans-serif (HeadingProTreble-Heavy, approximately Heavy weight, all capitals). Title size is about 16.3% of slide height per line, with the two lines set tight. No body text. Accent colours are orange #FE7000 and purple #7B3FE4 for the beam. Chevron is a 2-pixel-style white outline, no fill, with sharp corners. No shadows or rounded corners; the diagonal edge is a hard cut with a soft orange glow at the seam.
